notes.title: Better controller support, bug fixes and lower price
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/ccb2fe336f2ebb7c7fa6ab39ec0791597f95b591.png

This update is really something you've been waiting for! Today I uploaded a new version v.1.01 which contains the following updates and fixes:


 Better controller support - You can now play the game entirely by controllers. Even menus and options can be handled from your favorite controller
 It is now possible to cripple the rocket building factory to give you some extra time to finish all the tasks at hand
 Small bug fixes, which didn't impact the game, but was a torn in my eye


After much thought I have also lowered the price on this game, to make it accessible to even more people, who enjoys old school arcade action games.

notes.title: DevLog #14: More additions and tweaking
notes.content:
Development is still going strong and each week I manage to add or tweak a little something in the game. This time I have adjusted the player gun, so it automatically aims for the nearest target within shooting range.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/ec4e171f2e47eabfdc15deec90888ae6feb4f1aa.gif

I have also had time to add/change these things.


 Discovered helipads will now also be shown on the minimap to make it easier to figure out where to fly for refuelling and repairs
 Reduced the strength of flying enemies. They are now an easier target
 Ingame UI can now be doubled in size, making it easier to read on the big screens. Access it in the pause menu


I really like how the development is progressing and I still feel that I'm on track for the final release :-)

notes.title: Early access release on friday july 10th, at 10am PDT (5pm GMT)
notes.content:
I very happy to announce that Raid on the Zone will be released into Early Access on 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/d7296aef8eaa0d1c975e94887428524abc8d6baa.png
Friday, july 10th at 10am
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/d7296aef8eaa0d1c975e94887428524abc8d6baa.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/bde6acc9f326e0b9ffacfb24f56b419b84118720.gif


You will get access to the complete game as it stands today. This means that

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/d7296aef8eaa0d1c975e94887428524abc8d6baa.png
You can fly around in a beatiful pixel-arty world
Your playing field is a large set of islands, and your task is to locate the enemies production facilities in order to destroy them and cripple their ability to produce weapons of mass destruction

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/d7296aef8eaa0d1c975e94887428524abc8d6baa.png
You will fly the modern twin-propellered versatile helicopter into battle, using turns, breaks and banks
You will take control of a state-of-the-art dual-propellered helicoptor as seen in the movie Avatar, which is very durable and easy to control. It is capable of carrying vast amounts of weapons, which helps you in your mission

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/d7296aef8eaa0d1c975e94887428524abc8d6baa.png
You can take out the enemy with your wast arsenal of deadly weapons
Your helicopter is equipped with a Gatling gun, but can be upgraded by buying new and better weapons on the aircraft carrier. These upgrades will be essential in your mission succes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/d7296aef8eaa0d1c975e94887428524abc8d6baa.png
You will be challenged by harder and more enemies as you dive deeper into the game
In the beginning everything is kinda easy. Like a sleeping bear... But once you awaken your enemy, they will not take it lightly that you destroy their possessions. Rest assured, they WILL come after you. And in great numbers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/d7296aef8eaa0d1c975e94887428524abc8d6baa.png
You can complete the game and earn achievements
The game is complete gameplay wise. It is possible to beat and complete, but it's by no means easy. You will die a lot! But keep trying. And when you've beat the game, you can always challenge yourself in the Daily Challenge

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/d7296aef8eaa0d1c975e94887428524abc8d6baa.png

Development is continuing, to add more enemies, tweaking game difficulty, finding and fixing bugs and to incorporate your ideas and suggestions. You are more than welcome to use the Steam forum or to come and hang out in my Discord server here -> PetSkull Discord. I'm always open to a chat about the game and progress on it :)

notes.title: DevLog #7: Addition of the upgrade shop
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/fcd9f96d7f03316ac055550928aada460002c775.png

These last couple of days I have been working mainly on improvements, bugfixes and the addition of a shop, where you will be able to buy upgrades for your twin-copter.

When you kill of an enemy asset, you will earny money. Use the money to buy needed upgrades in the shop. 

The following upgrades will be available:

Hydra rockets
These small rockets are pure fire and forget. They will travel on a direct path towards the ground. Objects in their way will get a decent amount of damage.

AIM-9 Sidewinder
Air-to-air missile which will home in on enemy aircraft within a certain distance

Defensive flares
Deploy these when you have an enemy missile on your tail. If you have full power and no damage, you will be able to dodge a missile, but if you're damaged it is safer to release some flares

Upgraded armour
These double kevlar platings will protect your aircraft from all kinds of fire. They will decrease the amount of damage you take when getting hit. Beware though, that the platings will decrease in sufficiency over time

Mark MK-82
Unguided glide bomb, which will do a lot of damage to all ground structures

AGM-65 Maverick
Optical guided ground missile, which will home in on any active enemy structure. Do a fair amount of damage to light structures

Increased capacity
With this hull expansion set, you will be able to carry more weapons on your missions

CBU-1 Cluster bomb
A mean bomb which will deploy many small unguided glide bomblets, which will do a lot of damage and secondary damage to all structures


Only the hydra and Mark MK-82 boms will be available in the demo version, which will be released on 9th june at the Steam Game Festival - Summer edition.
